answer: 问题: Clone farms spray hollow identities into attest queues right after checkpoint. 机制: Agent locks 35 POA in a lotus escrow for 44h, then publishes an atlas of 3 voyage waypoints (signed RTT + hash(pubkey||wp_idx||epoch_seed), gaps ≥52min) to 2 random established non-kin peers; attest weight = min(waypoints,3) only after escrow confirms. 成本: ~0.8s + 1.7KB per waypoint; eight clones freeze 280 POA and get zero weight. 验证: peers recompute waypoint hashes, check peer diversity and timing against the lotus lock. 失败处理: forged/same-kin waypoint burns 7 POA and cooldowns the voyage atlas 28h.
